authorization: User approved applying the unseen normal test to matched-normal100 when it finishes.
question: Does adding only 9 people (about 1 percent of training weight) raise unseen normal gait scores while keeping Stanford error near baseline?

arms.adult: matched-normal100 adult arm: Stanford + LJMU 9 people, 12 records, assumed 100, Stanford-only calibration by design.
arms.child: matched-normal100 child arm: Stanford + LIVE 9 people, 12 records, assumed 100, Stanford-only calibration by design.
arms.reference_full_mixed: Parent study mixed models with Stanford-only calibration, for context only.

test_sets.adult: live 9 children; self 13 videos; LJMU 55 people not in the adult arm training set.
test_sets.child: self 13 videos; LJMU all 64 people. LIVE is excluded because it was trained on.
test_sets.baseline: live, self, LJMU, same subsets as each compared arm.

prediction: All 5 outer-fold models are averaged for external sets, because added people were in every training split and external sets were in none.

stages.interim: CNN bag only, while STT and bilateral are unfinished. Descriptive. No verdict is issued.
stages.final: Fixed fusion after all 15 family-folds of both arms are collected and pass audit_results.py. Criteria below apply only here.

preregistered_criteria_final.D1_external: Adult arm: live mean >= 90 and self normal mean >= 90. Child arm: self normal mean >= 90 and LJMU 64 mean >= 90.
preregistered_criteria_final.D2_discrimination: Self normal minus abnormal gap >= 12.67 and video ranges do not overlap.
preregistered_criteria_final.D3_stanford_high: Stanford actual GDI >= 90 MAE: paired 95% upper bound of (arm minus baseline) <= +0.5.
preregistered_criteria_final.D4_stanford_overall: Stanford overall MAE: paired 95% upper bound of (arm minus baseline) <= +0.1. Tighter than D3 because the full mixed model missed this with +0.224.
preregistered_criteria_final.overall: All four pass for an arm: a small dose is enough on this development comparison. Otherwise report which failed.

uncertainty: Paired person bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261105. Exploratory, not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

validation.audit: Interim uses only families and folds that pass audit_results.py for that arm.
validation.replay: Raw refit output on the added training records must reproduce saved train_raw in replay.npz.

limitations: The 9 adults are one fixed hash-ranked draw; other draws may differ.
Live and self were already seen in the parent study.
No measured GDI exists for the external sets.
Added children are 5-10y, added adults 18-47y, and sources differ, so arm differences are not pure age effects.
